integrity: A finite exhaustive standalone pure-Python certificate enumerates every point, secant line, and center; a second implementation computes all 4161 center values independently from polynomial roots. The report does not claim independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact center-marked splitting-fiber profile only for the specified cubic over the field of 64 elements; no theorem for all finite fields, no classification modulo automorphisms, and possible unindexed earlier fine-incidence table. Global completeness already known from 2015.
title: Exact splitting-fiber stratification of projections of a Hermitian elliptic cubic over \(\mathbb F_{64}\)
